name: What are common signs of mold in a commercial property?

mainEntity.name: What are common signs of mold in a commercial property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of mold in a commercial property include a persistent musty odor, visible discoloration (patches of black, green, or white) on walls, ceilings, floors, or furnishings, and water stains on surfaces. Employees or tenants may also report unexplained allergy-like symptoms such as sneezing, coughing, watery eyes, or skin irritation. Promptly addressing these signs can help prevent further spread and potential health impacts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common signs are a musty odor, visible discoloration on surfaces, and unexplained allergy-like symptoms among occupants.
